description: The marker alone on a line inside an interpolation is a variable reference
notes: The spec says the heredoc ends when its identifier appears again on a line of its own, with no exception for lines inside an interpolation sequence. hashicorp/hcl only looks for the marker while scanning literal text; inside ${ ... } it scans ordinary expression tokens (the heredocTemplate and main machines in hclsyntax/scan_tokens.rl), so EOT here is a variable.
